correctness.rationale: Cintioli Theorem 1.2 gives Join Property for every nonempty P∩[σ] in one special P⊆GL1. The SAME paper Proposition A.2 says any Join-Property class R has a countably infinite generalized-low jump-inversion *degree* fibre for each A≥_T0′. Apply to R=P∩[σ]; every B∈P is GL1, so B′≡_T B⊕0′ and the restricted generalized-low condition reduces to B′≡_T A. Every relatively open set contains a basic slice, proving density. Each B with B′≡_T A is A-computable (B≤_T B′≤_T A), so there are only countably many actual reals in whole fibre. The source theorems are genuine premises, with no computational extrapolation.
